why: Restores the pre-#1058 line (issue #1058; modelled on loop-renderer-ignores-the-stored-quality-preset): the Settings control writes the palette, the store persists it, the page paints it back, and every session still builds in Classic unless a developer flag says otherwise. A player can find the control, choose High contrast, watch the button agree, and never see it. The only witness is what the renderer and the stock chips were handed.
killedBy: startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default builds the session in the STORED owner palette when no flag is set (issue #1058)
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default lets ?dev=1&ownerPalette= OVERRIDE the stored palette, without writing it
startGameWith: the Player colors setting survives a reload (issue #1058) a High contrast choice made through the toggle reaches the next session's renderer and stock chips
